svg.title: Aditya Kumar Jha: GIS Engineer at Survey of India
svg.desc: Terminal-style profile card. Halftone portrait of Aditya Kumar Jha beside a list: GIS engineer, Survey of India Geodetic and Research Branch, Dehradun; GNSS processing with GAMIT/GLOBK and PRIDE PPP-AR; Python, QGIS, ArcGIS Pro, LiDAR, PostGIS.
